roleContext.jobDescription: Brackenhurst Logistics runs contract warehouses for retail and healthcare clients. The Warehouse Systems Coordinator configures the warehouse management system, writes work instructions, trains operatives on handheld scanning, arranges devices with IT and leads system changes into live operation on working shifts, staying on the floor to support users after cut-over. Each site runs two or three shifts a day, healthcare clients require batch and expiry capture on every scan, and the coordinator works with site general managers, client account teams and the IT service desk. System changes follow a cut-over plan agreed with the site general manager and are rehearsed in a training instance first.

requirements.text: Configures putaway and picking rules in a warehouse management system.
Writes work instructions for warehouse system processes.
Has taken a warehouse system change into live operation on a working shift and supported users after cut-over.
Trains warehouse operatives on handheld scanning.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Warehouse Systems Coordinator

## Experience

- Inventory Systems Assistant, Fellgate Distribution, November 2022 to August 2024: set up putaway and pick-face rules in the WMS training instance for a new handheld scanning workflow, covering three temperature zones and two pick-face sizes.
- Wrote 14 illustrated work instructions for receiving, putaway and replenishment on the handheld scanners, each with photographs of the scanner screens and the exception steps.
- Trained 40 operatives over two weeks of half-day sessions in the training warehouse, a mocked-up aisle stocked with dummy cartons, keeping attendance records for each session.
- Registered 60 handheld scanners with the IT service desk, checking each device's enrolment and app version before issue, and kept the device register up to date.
- Handheld scanning rollout at the Daventry site: per the client's account director, the new workflow 'has been live on every shift since the spring', with no paper pick lists left.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the report from two rehearsal nights in the training instance, listing the scripted scenarios, the scan errors found and the fixes applied, with a cover note listing the open actions to close before a cut-over date could be set, including a missing label printer and two unresolved scan errors.
